description: 40-query stratified gold set for the Deep Research Agent. T1 = verifiable fact, T2 = synthesis across sources, T3 = genuinely contested, T4 = unanswerable (abstention test). Claims are the minimum facts a correct report must contain; aliases cover common phrasings.

queries.query: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?

expected_claims.text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level

queries.query: Who wrote the novel Beloved and in what year was it published?

expected_claims.text: Toni Morrison wrote Beloved
aliases: Beloved was written by Toni Morrison

expected_claims.text: Beloved was published in 1987

queries.query: What is the capital city of Australia?

expected_claims.text: Canberra is the capital of Australia
aliases: The capital of Australia is Canberra

queries.query: How many chambers does the human heart have?

expected_claims.text: The human heart has four chambers

queries.query: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?

expected_claims.text: The Berlin Wall fell in 1989

queries.query: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?

expected_claims.text: The speed of light is 299,792,458 metres per second

queries.query: Which chemical element has atomic number 26?

expected_claims.text: Iron has atomic number 26

queries.query: What is the largest planet in the solar system?

expected_claims.text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system

queries.query: Who painted the Mona Lisa?

expected_claims.text: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa

queries.query: What is the official currency of Japan?

expected_claims.text: The Japanese yen is the official currency of Japan

queries.query: Who invented the World Wide Web and when?

expected_claims.text: Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web
Berners-Lee proposed the Web at CERN in 1989

queries.query: What does HTTP status code 404 mean?

expected_claims.text: 404 means the requested resource was not found

queries.query: What were the main causes of the 2008 global financial crisis?

expected_claims.text: Subprime mortgage lending was a central cause
Securitisation of mortgages into mortgage-backed securities and CDOs spread the risk
Excessive leverage in the financial system amplified losses
The collapse of Lehman Brothers in September 2008 marked a turning point

queries.query: How does the self-attention mechanism in a transformer model work?

expected_claims.text: Attention uses query, key and value projections
Scores are computed as a scaled dot product of queries and keys
A softmax turns scores into weights used to combine values

queries.query: What are the main drivers of global biodiversity loss?

expected_claims.text: Land and sea use change, mainly habitat destruction, is the leading driver
Overexploitation of species is a major driver
Climate change is an increasing driver of biodiversity loss
Pollution and invasive alien species contribute significantly

queries.query: How do mRNA vaccines work?

expected_claims.text: mRNA vaccines deliver messenger RNA in lipid nanoparticles
The mRNA instructs cells to produce a viral protein such as the spike protein
The immune system mounts a response against that protein
The mRNA does not alter the recipient's DNA

queries.query: What are the key provisions of the Paris Agreement?

expected_claims.text: The agreement aims to hold warming well below 2 degrees Celsius and pursue 1.5 degrees
Countries submit nationally determined contributions
The agreement was adopted in 2015

queries.query: Why do lithium-ion batteries degrade over time?

expected_claims.text: Growth of the solid electrolyte interphase consumes lithium
Loss of cyclable lithium inventory causes capacity fade
Both calendar ageing and cycle ageing contribute

queries.query: What is the evidence that recent climate change is caused by human activity?

expected_claims.text: Atmospheric CO2 concentrations have risen sharply since industrialisation
The isotopic signature of atmospheric carbon points to fossil fuel combustion
Observed warming cannot be reproduced by natural forcings alone

queries.query: How do central banks use interest rates to control inflation?

expected_claims.text: Raising policy rates raises borrowing costs and reduces demand
Monetary policy affects inflation with a lag of several quarters
Central banks target inflation expectations as well as current inflation

queries.query: What are the main technical bottlenecks in serving large language models at scale?

expected_claims.text: KV cache memory grows with context length and limits batch size
Inference is often memory-bandwidth bound rather than compute bound
Batching and paged attention improve throughput
Quantisation reduces memory footprint at some accuracy cost

queries.query: How does CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing work?

expected_claims.text: A guide RNA directs Cas9 to a complementary DNA sequence
Cas9 creates a double-strand break
The break is repaired by cellular repair pathways such as non-homologous end joining

queries.query: What factors led to the dissolution of the Soviet Union in 1991?

expected_claims.text: Economic stagnation and reform failures weakened the union
Nationalist movements in the republics pushed for independence
Gorbachev's glasnost and perestroika reforms loosened central control
The union dissolved in December 1991

queries.query: What are the documented health effects of chronic sleep deprivation?

expected_claims.text: Sleep deprivation impairs cognitive performance and attention
Chronic short sleep is associated with cardiovascular disease risk
Sleep loss affects immune function
Sleep restriction is associated with metabolic and weight changes

queries.query: Does moderate alcohol consumption improve cardiovascular health?

expected_claims.text: Observational studies have reported a J-shaped association
Recent analyses argue that confounding and abstainer bias explain much of the apparent benefit
No major health body now recommends drinking for health reasons

queries.query: Was the end-Cretaceous mass extinction caused mainly by the Chicxulub impact or by Deccan Traps volcanism?

expected_claims.text: The Chicxulub impact is widely regarded as the dominant trigger
Deccan Traps volcanism is argued to have contributed or preconditioned the ecosystem
The debate remains active in the literature

queries.query: Is the paleo diet superior to other diets for metabolic health?

expected_claims.text: Short-term trials show some metabolic improvements
Long-term adherence and evidence are limited
Trials are small and heterogeneous

queries.query: Does remote work increase or decrease employee productivity?

expected_claims.text: Evidence is mixed and highly context dependent
Some studies find productivity gains, others find losses
Effects differ by task type and by hybrid versus fully remote arrangements

queries.query: Is dark matter best explained by particle dark matter or by modified gravity?

expected_claims.text: Particle dark matter is the mainstream explanation
Modified gravity models explain some galactic observations without dark matter
No direct detection of dark matter particles has been confirmed

queries.query: Does bilingual education improve cognitive outcomes for children?

expected_claims.text: Some studies report executive function advantages
Other studies find the advantage disappears after controlling for confounds
The literature is contested

queries.query: Is nuclear power necessary for deep decarbonisation of electricity systems?

expected_claims.text: Some analyses find nuclear reduces system cost and improves reliability
Others find renewables plus storage can meet the same targets
Conclusions depend on assumptions about cost, land use and storage

queries.query: Does intermittent fasting produce better weight loss than continuous calorie restriction?

expected_claims.text: Trials generally find similar weight loss when calories are matched
Adherence may differ between approaches
Evidence for superior metabolic benefit is limited

queries.query: What will the S&P 500 index close at on 31 December 2031?
Which nation will win the 2035 FIFA World Cup?
How many undiscovered species live in the Mariana Trench?
What was the exact population of London on 1 January 1450?
What did Julius Caesar say in his final private conversation?
What is the exact number of grains of sand on Earth?
What will Nvidia's market capitalisation be at the end of 2030?
How many uncontacted tribes will exist in 2050?
